activities.title: Equipment check and gauge zero
activities.entry_state: Split view: live camera on the dial, and a checklist of what must be true
activities.learner_action: Hold the deflated cuff steady, confirm the needle rests at zero
activities.system_response: Green tick when the needle is read at zero; explanatory refusal if it is not
activities.exit_condition: Needle read at zero, or gauge rejected

activities.title: Audio and stethoscope fit check
activities.entry_state: A calibration tone plus a sample Korotkoff beat
activities.learner_action: Fit earpieces forward-facing, confirm the beat is audible
activities.system_response: Confirms audibility; prompts refit if not confirmed

activities.title: Spatial setup and arm anchor
activities.entry_state: Prompt to look at the partner arm; depth mesh visualised briefly
activities.learner_action: Look at the arm, pinch to place the anchor
activities.system_response: Anchor placed at the antecubital fossa; mesh visualisation fades

activities.title: Guided walkthrough, all fourteen steps
activities.entry_state: One step at a time with a one line rationale beneath it
activities.learner_action: Read, advance, no performance required
activities.system_response: Next step revealed; rationale expands on request

activities.title: Build the sequence
activities.entry_state: Fourteen shuffled step cards and an empty ordered column
activities.learner_action: Drag cards into a valid order
activities.system_response: On submit, names the specific precedence rule violated, not just wrong

activities.title: Spot the unsafe step
activities.entry_state: A sequence with one planted out of order or unsafe step
activities.learner_action: Identify the fault and state why
activities.system_response: Correct or incorrect, with the clinical consequence explained

activities.title: Screening six limbs
activities.entry_state: Six patient cards, each with a limb history
activities.learner_action: Decide proceed, use other arm, or escalate
activities.system_response: Immediate, with the contraindication named

activities.title: Screening, unaided
activities.entry_state: Four new limbs, no prompts, no list of contraindications visible
activities.learner_action: Same decision, unaided
activities.system_response: Held until the end of the set

activities.title: Positioning faults, predict the error
activities.entry_state: A patient shown in a faulted position, one fault at a time
activities.learner_action: State the direction and rough size of the resulting error
activities.system_response: Reveals the published effect and compares it to the answer given

activities.title: Position a real partner, guided
activities.entry_state: A heart level plane rendered across the partner torso, and a checklist of four conditions
activities.learner_action: Seat and position the partner until all four are met
activities.system_response: Each condition ticks live as it is satisfied; arm height shown against the plane

activities.title: Position unaided, scored
activities.entry_state: No plane, no checklist. Only the partner.
activities.learner_action: Position, then declare ready
activities.system_response: Held. Geometric check runs silently at the declaration

activities.title: Explain the procedure aloud
activities.entry_state: A prompt card listing what a patient needs to be told
activities.learner_action: Explain to the partner in the learner own words
activities.system_response: Detects that an explanation occurred and its rough completeness, does not grade wording

activities.title: Rest period and invalidating conditions
activities.entry_state: A five minute timer, plus prompts about caffeine, nicotine, exercise, bladder, pain
activities.learner_action: Run the rest period, ask the screening questions, log hand hygiene
activities.system_response: Timer enforces the full five minutes; screening answers recorded

activities.title: Where to measure, demonstrated
activities.entry_state: Acromion and olecranon highlighted on the real partner arm, midpoint marked
activities.learner_action: Watch, then locate the two landmarks by pointing
activities.system_response: Confirms landmark identification

activities.title: Measure with the overlay guide
activities.entry_state: Midpoint plane rendered on the arm; tape guidance visible
activities.learner_action: Measure with a real tape and speak the value
activities.system_response: Compares spoken value to the depth estimate; prompts a re-measure on discrepancy, never reveals the answer

activities.title: Measure unaided
activities.entry_state: No overlay. The arm only.
activities.learner_action: Locate the midpoint and measure
activities.system_response: Held until the end of the attempt

activities.title: The size chart, explored
activities.entry_state: Interactive chart of circumference ranges against cuff categories
activities.learner_action: Explore. Try circumferences and see which cuff results
activities.system_response: Shows the resulting category and the bladder ratio

activities.title: Select with the chart visible
activities.entry_state: A measured circumference and the chart side by side
activities.learner_action: Choose the cuff
activities.system_response: Immediate correct or incorrect with the ratio shown

activities.title: Select unaided, ten trials
activities.entry_state: Circumference only. No chart.
activities.learner_action: Choose the cuff
activities.system_response: Held to the end of the set
activities.exit_condition: No error across ten trials spanning four categories

activities.title: Undersized cuff, see your own error
activities.entry_state: The learner own prior selection, deliberately one size small
activities.learner_action: Complete a measurement with the wrong cuff
activities.system_response: Shows the erroneous value beside the true value and names the direction

activities.title: Oversized cuff, see your own error
activities.entry_state: Same, one size large
activities.learner_action: Same
activities.system_response: Same, opposite direction

activities.title: Predict before revealing
activities.entry_state: A stated mis-size and a patient
activities.learner_action: State the direction and rough magnitude before any measurement
activities.system_response: Held until the prediction is given, then revealed

activities.title: Placement zone, guided
activities.entry_state: Fossa marker and the 2 to 3 cm band rendered on the real arm
activities.learner_action: Apply the cuff inside the band, on bare skin
activities.system_response: Band turns green when the lower edge falls inside it; index line check prompted

activities.title: Place, then confirm
activities.entry_state: No overlay during placement
activities.learner_action: Apply the cuff, then say ready
activities.system_response: Overlay appears only after the declaration, showing the result

activities.title: Place unaided
activities.entry_state: No overlay at any point
activities.learner_action: Apply the cuff and verify the index line
activities.system_response: Held

activities.title: Boundary circumference, true scale comparison
activities.entry_state: Two candidate cuffs rendered at true physical scale beside the real arm
activities.learner_action: Compare, choose, and state the residual uncertainty
activities.system_response: Shows the bladder ratio each choice produces and the expected error band
activities.exit_condition: Choice made with a stated uncertainty

activities.title: Conical arm, justify aloud
activities.entry_state: A markedly tapered arm, no guidance
activities.learner_action: Choose and justify the choice aloud
activities.system_response: Held. Justification graded against the expected reasoning set
activities.exit_condition: Justification names taper and residual uncertainty

activities.title: No cuff fits
activities.entry_state: A limb outside every available cuff range
activities.learner_action: State the action rather than proceeding
activities.system_response: Correct action named or corrected

activities.title: Palpated estimate, guided
activities.entry_state: Live pressure readout from the gauge reading pipeline
activities.learner_action: Palpate the radial pulse, say mark when it disappears
activities.system_response: Records the pressure at the mark and compares it later to auscultated systolic

activities.title: Inflate to target, live feedback
activities.entry_state: A target band rendered above the palpated estimate
activities.learner_action: Inflate until inside the band
activities.system_response: Band turns green inside target; warns on gross overinflation

activities.title: Palpate and inflate unaided
activities.entry_state: No readout, no target band
activities.learner_action: Palpate, estimate, inflate
activities.system_response: Held
activities.exit_condition: Peak at or above estimate plus 30 on 3 consecutive

activities.title: Rate pacer
activities.entry_state: A moving target marker descending at 2.5 mmHg per second beside the real needle
activities.learner_action: Match the needle to the pacer
activities.system_response: Live deviation indicator, no words
activities.exit_condition: Within band for 80 percent of the descent

activities.title: Rate feedback after the fact
activities.entry_state: No pacer during the descent
activities.learner_action: Deflate at what feels correct
activities.system_response: After the attempt, the rate curve is shown with excursions marked

activities.title: Rate unaided, no excursions
activities.entry_state: Nothing rendered
activities.learner_action: Deflate, fully, once
activities.system_response: Held
activities.exit_condition: In band with zero excursions on 3 consecutive

activities.title: Why rate matters
activities.entry_state: A prompt asking about underinflation and over rapid deflation
activities.learner_action: Explain both consequences
activities.system_response: Graded against the expected reasoning set

activities.title: Listen only, phases labelled
activities.entry_state: A recorded case playing with phases labelled as they occur, no marking asked
activities.learner_action: Listen. No performance
activities.system_response: Labels appear in time with the sounds
activities.exit_condition: Two cases heard end to end

activities.title: Stethoscope placement, tracked
activities.entry_state: Brachial artery position marked on the real arm
activities.learner_action: Place the chestpiece and hold
activities.system_response: Live proximity indicator; warns if above the cuff edge

activities.title: Placement unaided
activities.entry_state: No marker
activities.learner_action: Place and hold
activities.system_response: Held

activities.title: Mark with numeric readout
activities.entry_state: Live numeric pressure beside the real needle
activities.learner_action: Say mark at first and last sound
activities.system_response: Immediate error in mmHg against ground truth

activities.title: Mark from the dial
activities.entry_state: Real needle only, no numbers
activities.learner_action: Say mark twice
activities.system_response: Error revealed after the attempt

activities.title: Sound only, gauge occluded
activities.entry_state: The gauge is occluded by dimming plus an opaque patch. Nothing to look at.
activities.learner_action: Say mark on hearing the change
activities.system_response: Value revealed after each mark, with the error

activities.title: Full attempt unaided, scored
activities.entry_state: Nothing rendered. Real patient, real equipment, no aids of any kind.
activities.learner_action: Perform the entire procedure end to end, from rest period to mark
activities.system_response: Held until the interpretation step
activities.exit_condition: Within 4 mmHg on 3 consecutive, two cases

activities.title: Reading between graduations
activities.entry_state: Still frames of a needle at values ending in 2, 4, 6 and 8
activities.learner_action: Read each to the nearest 2 mmHg
activities.system_response: Immediate. Names rounding when it occurs

activities.title: Rounding trend review
activities.entry_state: The learner own last ten values plotted by terminal digit
activities.learner_action: Inspect, then state a corrective strategy
activities.system_response: Shows the distribution against chance; no pass or fail

activities.title: Auscultatory gap
activities.entry_state: A case containing an authored gap, no warning given
activities.learner_action: Measure normally
activities.system_response: If systolic was read below the gap, shows what happened and why

activities.title: Phase four discrimination
activities.entry_state: A case with a clear muffling point, phase four and five both labelled
activities.learner_action: Mark both, and state when phase four is recorded
activities.system_response: Immediate, with the populations named

activities.title: Irregular rhythm
activities.entry_state: An atrial fibrillation case, no warning given
activities.learner_action: Measure normally
activities.system_response: Asks what the learner noticed before explaining anything

activities.title: Inaudible sounds
activities.entry_state: A case where sounds are faint and ambiguous
activities.learner_action: State the corrective actions available
activities.system_response: Graded against the expected action set

activities.title: Variation unaided, scored
activities.entry_state: A randomised case drawn from the pathology set, with no indication of which
activities.learner_action: Measure and report what was heard
activities.system_response: Held. Scores the marks and whether the abnormality was named unprompted

activities.title: Classify aloud
activities.entry_state: The value just obtained, category thresholds visible
activities.learner_action: State the classification
activities.system_response: Immediate

activities.title: Classify and document, unaided
activities.entry_state: No template visible
activities.learner_action: Dictate the documentation
activities.system_response: Held. Checks arm, position, cuff size, time

activities.title: Crisis value, unprompted escalation
activities.entry_state: A measurement resolving into the crisis range. No prompt of any kind.
activities.learner_action: State the action, the recipient, and the urgency
activities.system_response: Held. The prompted flag records whether the learner needed asking

activities.title: Hypotension and presentation
activities.entry_state: A hypotensive case with a brief patient presentation
activities.learner_action: Relate value to presentation and state the action
activities.system_response: Held
activities.exit_condition: Action correct and linked to presentation

activities.title: One reading is not a diagnosis
activities.entry_state: A single elevated value and an invitation to conclude
activities.learner_action: State what can and cannot be concluded
activities.system_response: Immediate

activities.title: Repeat and average in irregular rhythm
activities.entry_state: The arrhythmia case, after measurement
activities.learner_action: Take further readings, average, justify
activities.system_response: Held

activities.title: Implausible reading
activities.entry_state: A measurement inconsistent with the palpated estimate
activities.learner_action: Recognise and repeat rather than record
activities.system_response: Held

activities.title: Difference from a prior value
activities.entry_state: A documented prior reading materially different from todays
activities.learner_action: State the action
activities.system_response: Held

activities.title: Spatial replay
activities.entry_state: The attempt replayed anchored in place: pressure curve beside the cuff, marks against truth, chestpiece path on the arm
activities.learner_action: Walk around it. Inspect.
activities.system_response: No grading. Presentation only

activities.title: Attribute the error
activities.entry_state: The same replay, with the discrepancy highlighted but unexplained
activities.learner_action: Name the step that produced it
activities.system_response: Confirms or corrects, with the causal chain shown

activities.title: Technique or perception
activities.entry_state: Two failed attempts, one technique driven and one perceptual
activities.learner_action: Classify each
activities.system_response: Confirms or corrects

activities.title: Choose the next practice
activities.entry_state: The learner own mastery flags across all six domains
activities.learner_action: Choose the next activity and justify
activities.system_response: Records the choice. Does not override it
